turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, you're speaking with Daniel from Retailer One. Before we go any further I need to let you know that this call is being recorded for quality assurance and training purposes. Do I have your consent to continue on a recorded line?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yeah, that's fine, go ahead.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. Can I just confirm I'm speaking with the account holder, Nina Petrova, and that you're authorised to make changes to this account?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that's me. Nina Petrova, the account's in my name.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Perfect, thanks Nina. And the supply address is 40 Church Street, Richmond, Victoria, three one two one?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That's the one.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great. So this is about the Secure 12 plan. Before any numbers there's a short statement I'm required to read to you in full.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No worries.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The Default Market Offer is the reference price set by the Australian Energy Regulator. The estimated annual cost of this plan is seven per cent less than the reference price for an average household in your distribution zone. This is an estimate only, and your actual cost will depend on your usage.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, got it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: A couple of quick questions first. Does anyone at the property rely on life support equipment, and do you hold a concession card?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No to both.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me pull the pricing up, bear with me, the system's slow today.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sorry about the wait, thanks for holding.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: On the Secure 12 plan your usage rate is 29.7 cents per kilowatt hour including GST, and the daily supply charge is one hundred and four point nine cents a day.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hang on, is that including GST?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, including GST.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sorry, I talked over you, go on.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No worries at all.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The rate isn't locked, we'd give you written notice before any change and you could leave then with no exit fee. Are you happy for me to go ahead?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, let's do it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What's the best email for your welcome pack and contract? The cooling-off notice goes there too.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: nina dot petrova at yahoo dot com.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Lovely, got it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: And just to confirm the NMI off your bill, I've got 6 1 0 3 2 2 1 1 0 0 9. Does that match?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that matches.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: And this is electricity only, you're not bringing gas across?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Electricity only.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's everything. You'll get the welcome pack by email within one business day and your ten business day cooling-off period starts when it lands.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thanks Daniel, bye.
